title: Exactness and normalized descent interfaces for common-stage fibres
statement: Let k be a field and l a prime invertible in k. Fix the continuous rational realization family R and an algebraic closure Ω of Q_l. Use the finite type bases, finite-stage standard hearts, common heart, literal heart inclusions, actual scalar functors and actual completed pullbacks of [def-per-adic-fibre-comparison-data, lem-per-adic-common-stage-truncations, lem-per-adic-stratified-pullback-texact]. CommonStageHeartExactness packages additivity and preservation of homology of the inclusions, image comparison isomorphisms retaining both maps, eventual vanishing of finite-stage objects, common finite-stage representatives of finite complexes and short exact sequences, and additivity, faithfulness, preservation of homology and injective unit for scalar extension to Ω. Given normalized finite fibres ω and normalized finite comparisons α,β [lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-pullback, lem-per-adic-normalized-fibre-scalar], CommonStageFibreTransport packages exact additive finite-dimensional common-point functors with natural finite-stage comparison, natural actual pullback comparisons, scalar transitions normalized on pure tensors and pinned to transIso, pullback comparisons pinned to the underlying identity and α, and their identity and composition laws. CommonStageFibreDescent adds CommonStageHeartExactness and the four iff joint tests for zero objects, isomorphisms, zero arrows and short exact complexes. These are interfaces for the same actual categories and functors, not new models.
